sender.zh: 冒用股市名師、財經教授或知名企業家的臉書、IG、YouTube廣告，以及「投顧助理」LINE帳號
sender.en: Facebook, Instagram or YouTube ads using a famous stock “teacher”, finance professor or business leader, then an “investment adviser's assistant” on LINE

name.zh: 假投資：名人廣告拉你進LINE股票群組、下載假投資APP
name.en: Fake investment: celebrity ad, LINE stock group and a fake trading app

how.zh: 詐騙集團在社群平台投放冒用股市名人、財經教授的廣告，或貼出自稱「名人司機、助理」的投資文，引導你先加「投顧助理」LINE，再拉進LINE投資群組。群組裡有老師每天「授課」報明牌，還有很多假投資人貼獲利截圖。接著要你下載假的證券或投資APP，畫面上的獲利每天暴增，再要你匯款或把現金面交給「股務經理」儲值。等你想出金時，又要你先繳分潤費、保證金或稅金，最後錢全拿不回來。
how.en: Scammers run ads using famous stock commentators or finance professors, or post stories from a celebrity's “driver” or “assistant”, to get you to add an “adviser's assistant” on LINE and then join a LINE investment group. A “teacher” gives daily tips and fake investors post profit screenshots. You are told to install a fake brokerage or investment app whose balance grows every day, and to transfer money or hand cash to a “stock manager” to top up. When you try to withdraw, they demand a profit share, deposit or tax first, and the money never comes back.

text.zh: 在臉書、IG或YouTube看到名人投資廣告或貼文，被引導加LINE。
text.en: An ad or post with a famous investor leads you to add a LINE account.

text.zh: 被拉進LINE投資群組，老師報明牌，群組成員不斷曬獲利。
text.en: You are added to a LINE investment group where a “teacher” gives tips and members show off profits.

text.zh: 要你下載非官方的投資APP，匯款或面交現金給專人儲值。
text.en: You are told to install an unofficial trading app and transfer money or hand cash to someone to top it up.

text.zh: 想領出獲利時，被要求先繳分潤費、保證金或稅金。
text.en: When you want to withdraw, you are told to pay a profit share, deposit or tax first.

text.zh: 您好，我是老師的助理。老師這週在LINE群組免費帶大家布局AI概念股，今天布局、明天驗證，名額有限，加入請點：[連結]
text.en: Hello, I'm the teacher's assistant. This week the teacher is guiding everyone in the LINE group on AI stocks for free: position today, see results tomorrow. Places are limited; join here: [link]

text.zh: 恭喜您抽中新股！請於今日下午三點前完成認繳，金額請匯入公司指定帳戶或由股務經理到府收款，逾時視同放棄。
text.en: Congratulations, you have been allocated new shares! Complete payment by 3 p.m. today by transferring to the company account or handing it to the stock manager who will come to you; otherwise you forfeit them.

zh: 看到名人投資廣告加了LINE被拉進股票群組
股票老師在LINE群組報明牌叫我買
投資APP顯示賺很多但是不能出金
要先繳分潤費才可以領出獲利
投顧助理叫我把現金交給股務經理
說抽中新股要我馬上匯款認購
en: i clicked a celebrity investment ad and was added to a line stock group
a stock teacher in a line group gives tips and tells me what to buy
the investment app shows big profits but i cannot withdraw
they want a profit share fee before i can take out my gains
the adviser assistant told me to hand cash to a stock manager
they said i won a share allocation and must pay right away

zh: 名人或財經專家在廣告裡拉你加LINE、進投資群組
保證獲利、穩賺不賠、今天布局明天驗證
要你下載不是從官方商店來的投資APP
要你把現金交給專人或匯到個人帳戶
想出金卻要先繳分潤費、保證金或稅金
en: A celebrity or finance expert in an ad asks you to add them on LINE or join an investment group.
Guaranteed profits, no risk, “position today, see results tomorrow”.
You are told to install an investment app that is not from an official store.
You are asked to hand cash to someone or transfer to a personal account.
You must pay a profit share, deposit or tax before you can withdraw.

zh: 名人不會在LINE群組帶人投資；別加廣告裡的LINE帳號
投資前先用金管會的資料查證業者是否合法，或打1998、165問
不要把現金交給任何「股務經理」或專人，也不要匯到個人帳戶
已經匯款請馬上報警或打165，並聯絡銀行
en: Famous investors do not run LINE investment groups; don't add the LINE account in an ad.
Before investing, check the firm with the FSC or call 1998 or 165.
Never hand cash to a “stock manager” or courier, or transfer to a personal account.
If you already paid, report it to the police or 165 at once and call your bank.
